set.body: Review finding from eco-u4-predictive: ScalaFIM AlderSoftLda (modules/mvpa-dataset .../predictive/AlderSoftLda.scala) duplicates mvpa4s AlderOperatorRidge's operator lifecycle: verify/sample-count/budget admission, the fold loop with fixedHoldout and OperatorRowMismatch/DuplicateAssessment/MissingAssessment assembly, the training-row walk and stableKeys. Pre-existing duplication. Consider an operator-learner template in mvpa4s-predictive parameterized by fit/predict/assemble so the soft-LDA adapter supplies only the mvpa-fit kernel. Must preserve persisted fingerprint/schema strings and existing JVM/JS evidence.
set.title: Share the operator-learner lifecycle between AlderOperatorRidge and AlderSoftLda
